title: polyalthia biglandulosa
intro: Polyalthia biglandulosa, commonly known as the "Indian Laburnum" or "Bijasal", is a flowering plant species in the family Annonaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
